scenes.name: intro
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: she stands tall and slowly raises her chin, one arm curving up in front of her, and ends with the arm held high
she draws a slow circle with her wrist above her head while her other hand rests on her hip, and ends with both hands on her hips
she stomps her heels on the floor three times, arching her back with each stomp, and ends with her chin raised

scenes.name: main
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: she slowly raises both arms overhead, wrists twisting in circular flamenco wrist-work, and ends with arms high
she claps her hands sharply above her head once and snaps her face toward the camera, then holds
she spins once, her skirt flaring out in a wide arc around her legs, and ends facing the camera as the skirt settles
she steps forward with a sharp heel strike and sweeps one arm across her body, and ends with the arm extended to the side
she stomps twice more, faster, with her hands framing her face, and ends still with her hands raised
she spins in the other direction, skirt flaring, and ends facing the camera with one hand on her hip

scenes.name: finale
scenes.style_tail: , static camera, cinematic studio lighting, photorealistic, one continuous dance movement at a steady moderate tempo, highly detailed

beats.prompt: she slowly lowers both arms in a wide arc down to her sides, and ends with palms resting on her thighs
she strikes a proud final stance, one hand on her hip and head tilted back, and holds it perfectly still
she relaxes the pose, breathes out and smiles at the camera, and ends standing still
